title: Muddy Paws | Mobile Dog Grooming in Cheshire — We Come to You
desc: Fully equipped mobile dog grooming van covering Cheshire. One dog at a time, no cages, no waiting. Book your regular slot online.
h1: Grooming without the stressful day out.
sub: A fully equipped grooming salon that parks on your driveway. One dog at a time, no cages, no waiting around in kennels — just your dog, your groomer, and about ninety minutes.
svc_l: Prices vary a little with size and coat condition. Send a photo and we will confirm before we book you in.

services.title: Full groom
services.desc: Bath, blow dry, full clip or hand strip, nails, ears and a finishing spritz. The works.

services.title: Bath & tidy
services.desc: Wash, dry, nail trim and a tidy of face, feet and rear. Perfect between full grooms.

services.title: Puppy's first groom
services.desc: A gentle, short introduction session so grooming never becomes something to dread.

services.title: De-shedding treatment
services.desc: Specialist bath and rake for double-coated breeds. Dramatically less hair on your sofa.

services.title: Hand stripping
services.desc: Correct coat care for terriers and wire-haired breeds, done by hand the way it should be.

services.title: Nails, ears & anal glands
services.desc: Quick welfare visits without a full groom. Ten minutes on the driveway.

about_h: Kirsty, a van, and a lot of very relaxed dogs.
about_p: Muddy Paws is Kirsty Bell, City & Guilds qualified with nine years in salons before going mobile. The van has hot water, a hydraulic table, proper lighting and heating. Your dog is never caged and never waits — the session starts when Kirsty arrives and your dog goes straight back inside afterwards. Nervous and elderly dogs are a speciality.

reviews.quote: Our rescue lurcher panics in salons. Kirsty did three short sessions to build him up and now he trots to the van on his own.
reviews.name: Nicola Grant

reviews.quote: The convenience is unreal. She grooms him on the drive while I work and I do not lose half a Saturday sat in a waiting room.
reviews.name: Paul Ridley

reviews.quote: Our old collie is fourteen and arthritic. Kirsty works around him, takes breaks, never rushes. That care is worth every penny.
reviews.name: Fiona Mackay

faq.q: Do you need my water or electricity?
faq.a: No. The van is completely self-contained with its own water, heating and power, so all we need is somewhere legal to park near your door.

faq.q: How long does a groom take?
faq.a: A full groom is usually 90 minutes to two hours depending on coat and size. You will get a text when we are fifteen minutes away.

faq.q: What if my dog is nervous?
faq.a: Tell us when you book. Nervous and elderly dogs are what we are best at — we will take it at their pace, over several short visits if needed.
